This project is a work in progress - resurrecting the F3 programming language.

Lazy and reactive evaluation with mutation

Support for generics including type constructors

Syntax - eschew punctuation in favor of natural language (english) function words where possible

{{{
function of (A, B, C) curry(f: function from (A, B) to C): function from A to (function from B to C)
{
    function(a: A): function from B to C
    {
        function(b: B): C
        {
            f(a, b)
        }
    }
}

function of (A, B, C) uncurry(f: function from A to (function from B to C)): function from (A, B) to C
{
    function(a: A, b: B): C
    {
        f(a)(b)
    }
}
}}}

Monad Comprehensions
{{{

// Lazy infinite streams

public class Stream of A extends Comonad of (Stream, A), Monad of (Stream, A) {

    public val protected var first: A;
    public val protected var secondThruLast: Stream of A;

    // zip lifts a binary operator to one over Streams
    public function of (B, C) 
	zip(binOp: function from (A, B) to C, 
	    bs: Stream of B): Stream of C
    {
	Stream of C
	{
	    first: bind binOp(first, bs.first);
	    secondThruLast: bind secondThruLast.zip(binOp, bs.secondThruLast);
	}
    }

    // map lifts a unary operator to one over Streams
    override public function of B 
	map(unaryOp: function from A to B): Stream of B
    {
	Stream of B
	{
	    first: bind unaryOp(this.first);
	    secondThruLast: bind this.secondThruLast.map(unaryOp);
	}
    }

    // flatmap = join . map
    override public function of X 
	flatmap(unaryOp: function from A to Monad of (Stream, X)): Stream of X
    {
	var h = bind unaryOp(first) as Stream of X;
	var t = bind secondThruLast.map(bound function(a: A): X {
		(unaryOp(a) as Stream of X).first
	    });
	Stream of X { 
	    first: bind h.first;
	    secondThruLast: bind t;
	}
    }

    // map lifts a unary operator to one over Streams
    override function of B 
	coflatmap(unaryOp: function from Comonad of (Stream, A) to B): Stream of B
    {
	Stream of B
	{
	    first: bind unaryOp(this);
	    secondThruLast: bind secondThruLast.coflatmap(unaryOp) as Stream of B;
	}
    }

    override public function extract(): A { first }

    public bound function fby(s:Stream of A): Stream of A 
    {
	Stream of A {
	    first: bind first;
	    secondThruLast: bind s; 
	}
    }
}

// lifts a constant to a Stream i.e,  t, t, t, ...
public function of T constant(t: T): Stream of T
{
    Stream of T {
        first: t;
        override var secondThruLast = this;
    }
}


// creates an infinite stream of 3s
let zs = for (xs in constant(1.0), ys in constant(2.0)) { x + y }

}}}
